summary.text: Gabe Firment is a Republican state representative who has represented Louisiana House District 22 since 2020 and has chaired the House Insurance Committee in the 2025-2026 term. He has worked in the construction and insurance industries. He is one of three sitting state legislators running in the Republican field for this open seat.

paragraphs.text: Born around 1970 or 1971 and graduated from Tioga High School in 1989.
Earned a B.S. in public administration from Louisiana College (1994) and an M.B.A. from Louisiana Tech University.
Outside politics, has worked in the construction and insurance industries.
Elected to the Louisiana House of Representatives, District 22, in November 2019 and took office on January 13, 2020, succeeding Terry Brown; he was re-elected without opposition in 2023.
Has served on the House Insurance, Retirement, and Transportation, Highways and Public Works committees, and was assigned to chair the House Insurance Committee in 2025-2026.
